root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately after `if_common()` allocates a `ddsi_config_networkpartition_listelem`, `if_network_partition()` must initialize `new->interface_names` to `NULL` before any later cleanup can free the `Interface` attribute slot. Otherwise parse-failure cleanup can pass an indeterminate pointer to `ddsrt_free`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is the missing null initialization of the `Interface` attribute storage in the freshly allocated `NetworkPartition` list node. The vulnerable original leaves `new->interface_names` indeterminate at the rooted initializer event, while the fixed original records `new->interface_names == NULL` at the same source site and still exercises the later cleanup free.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates this predicate at `network_partition_init_post` and still reaches `interface_free_sink`. The fixed original reaches the same protected free with `new->interface_names == NULL`, so the required assertion is genuinely witnessed without perturbation.

nodes.state: `ff_free()` reaches `ddsrt_free(*elem)` with `*elem` still equal to the `interface_names` field value carried by the partially initialized `NetworkPartition` node, so cleanup frees that stale pointer value at the sanitizer-reported sink.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `network_partition_init_post.interface_names_after_init == interface_free_sink.free_argument`.

edges.relation: The `interface_names` field value left in the freshly allocated `NetworkPartition` node is carried unchanged to `ff_free()` and becomes the `*elem` argument passed to `ddsrt_free` for the `Interface` attribute cleanup.
